summary: 10.0.34.04 Enterprise Release - Resolve Payment Controller syntax, Stock Register actions, and Settings branding preview
highlights: 1. Record Payment Controller: Fixed fatal syntax error in object literal breaking RecordPaymentController, sales/purchase/return payment views and all modal triggers
2. Stock Register Parity: Standardized purple actions dropdown (Stock Adjustment, Movement History, Barcode Label Print, Stock Revaluation)

3. Settings Branding Assets: Added live interactive thumbnails, file uploads, delete/clear triggers and fullscreen preview lightbox for Company Banner, Watermark, UPI QR, Header Logo, and Digital Seal
4. Invoice Terms & Conditions: Expanded defaults editor textarea to full-sized 6-row view
